name: Andres Ramos
office: Compton Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Andres Ramos has served on the Compton Community College District board since 2007. He says he served in the Navy Reserve and works for AT&T. He says his accomplishments include the college regaining accreditation in 2019 and voters passing Measure C in 2014. A 251-bed student housing project broke ground in 2025. In his 2022 campaign, he said his goals included growing dual enrollment, vocational education, and improving facilities.
